# Emirates Group Careers

> Official careers portal for Emirates Group, offering employment opportunities across aviation, hospitality, and ground services divisions in the UAE.

Emirates Group Careers is the primary recruitment hub for Emirates, dnata, and affiliated organizations operating across the United Arab Emirates. The site connects job seekers with career opportunities in the aviation industry, graduate programs, and specialized roles while promoting the employer brand and employee benefits.
